episode.title: Why This 1957 Kitchen Ad Sends a Stove Into Orbit
episode.headline:
A KITCHEN AD.
A STOVE IN SPACE?

beats.text: Why does a kitchen ad send a stove into orbit?
This is a nineteen fifty-seven dream of the perfect kitchen.
First, it diagrams the wasted footsteps.
Then the cabinets appear... and the whole kitchen starts orbiting.
So what does thirteen minutes of this fantasy lead to?
A kitchen-planning booklet. All that spectacle. For a floor plan.
